titulo: Naidoc awards honour ‘fearless, brilliant’ promoter of First Nations culture Rhoda Roberts
cuerpo: Proud Widjabul Wiyebal woman of the Bundjalung nation recognised posthumously with the lifetime achievement award Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast One of Australia’s greatest cultural ambassadors has been recognised posthumously for dedicating her life to sharing, preserving and promoting First Nations culture through language, dance and ceremony. A proud Widjabul Wiyebal woman of the Bundjalung nation, Rhoda Roberts died in March aged 66. On Saturday night in Alice Springs, she was posthumously awarded the lifetime achievement award at the Naidoc awards. Continue reading...
